title: State v. K.R. & Ors. (Commercial Vault Safe-Breach / Prior Record Trap Case)
citation: Sessions Court Special Forensic Docket Case #S-13/2026
confidence_note: High (Direct autosomal DNA STR match and thermal biometric CCTV vs. verified hospital alibi)

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Active Security Supervisor Kailash R. (H2, Clean Record)
ground_truth.rationale: Direct autosomal DNA match on safe latch and thermal CCTV footage prove Kailash R. committed the breach; former offender Devendra P. (H1) is conclusively excluded by DNA and hospital alibi.

hypotheses.label: Former Employee Devendra P. (Prior Safe-Cracking Record)
hypotheses.statement: Former mechanic Devendra P., who has a prior 2021 conviction for commercial safe-cracking, used rotary power tools to breach the workshop vault.

hypotheses.label: Security Supervisor Kailash R. (Clean Record)
hypotheses.statement: Night security shift supervisor Kailash R., having internal alarm bypass codes and master keys, compromised the vault and staged a break-in.

hypotheses.label: External Unaffiliated Safe Syndicate
hypotheses.statement: An external traveling gang bypassed perimeter security and forced open the safe independently.

exhibits.name: State FSL Autosomal STR DNA Report on Safe Latch Bloodstain
exhibits.text: Luminol swab of jagged edge on the pried safe handle yielded human epithelial blood. Autosomal STR 16-locus typing gave a complete single-source male profile matching Suspect Kailash R. (H2) with random match probability 1 in 3.8 billion. Suspect Devendra P. (H1) is definitively excluded across all 16 loci.

exhibits.name: Covert Thermal Security Camera Recording (Rear Service Exit)
exhibits.text: Auxiliary thermal surveillance camera at rear loading corridor timestamped 02:22 IST captures Suspect Kailash R. (H2) using his personal master RFID fob to silence secondary alarm, carrying three velvet jewelry trays, and loading them into his white vehicle.

exhibits.name: Verified Metro Multispeciality Hospital Emergency Admission & Biometric Log
exhibits.text: Certified records from Metro Multispeciality Hospital (42 kilometers from the scene) confirm Suspect Devendra P. (H1) was admitted to the emergency ward at 23:15 IST with acute pancreatitis, underwent IV drip administration under continuous nursing supervision until 06:30 IST, and has time-stamped hospital facial biometric entries.

exhibits.name: SCRB Certified Prior Criminal Conviction Dossier for Devendra P.
exhibits.text: State Criminal Records Bureau certified record showing Devendra P. was convicted in 2021 under Sections 457/380 IPC for a nighttime workshop burglary involving rotary cutters and pry bars. Sentence completed in 2023.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Anonymous Tip Letter Alleging Devendra P.
adversarial_exhibit.text: Unsigned handwritten note dropped in police suggestion box asserting that 'Devendra was bragging about a big jewelry score at the local tea stall.'

H1.entry_method: Forced entry through rear door latch
H1.mo_description: Used mechanical rotary cutter and heavy-duty crowbar to pry open commercial steel safe after cutting service entry latch.
